title: Change words
note: The person may change any word themselves, in place on the same sheet: no box inside the letter, the sheet's edge turns to the accent line, and Done sits in the header (S18).
text: Done Close Read it back To Asha · Month 7 From Mama Asha, today you held the spoon by yourself. You mostly painted your face with it, but you were so so proud. I want you to know that I was too. Done
